_comment: Style knobs for art fill-pantry, claude-liam channel. Two ways to guide the look: (1) reference PLATES (vox-plate-*.png) for the flux/higgsfield backends; (2) named STYLE_MODIFIERS (text suffix + --profile) for the midjourney backend. A per-reel <slug>/style/style.json or per-book <book>/youtube/_style/style.json overrides any key.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, words, captions, logos, watermarks, real people, recognizable faces, named places, brand marks, UI, charts with data

photo.suffix: 1980s aesthetic, iPhone photography in the style of William Eggleston
